title: Even-effort GAP splits
caveats: C2 GAP caveat (v2_27cities): published Huber coef_grade≈1.579 differs in magnitude vs grade-only OLS coef_grade≈2.97 (both same sign; controls shrink/shift grade effect) (aux.grade_only_ols in gap_curve.json). Cause: mid_km+post20 collinearity / course-structure confound. Prefer grade-only slope for intuitive GAP sensitivity; full model for fatigue-adjusted prediction. See docs/C2-GAP-FIT.md. PRIOR v1_6majors Huber coef_grade≈-0.586 DID flip vs grade-only OLS ≈+5.68.
CRITICAL: features_v2.gap_pace_* / gap_dos_* are from v1_6majors curve — IGNORED. Live recompute: observed pace_* / gap_multiplier(grade,mid_km,post20) with CURRENT curve.
Elev gaps stay null for Melbourne (and any city without GPX/course_segments) — never invent elev.
notes: Even-effort GAP with LIVE v2_27cities multipliers (as_of=2026-09-07T00:31:38Z, md5=5bc86aa1714d5c31689539b6ce6d7f09). Observed segment paces vs live gap-adjusted paces; positive split vs live GAP split. Full features_v2 corpus (n_rows_used=2512860). Stored gap_pace_* not used.
method: Filter valid_splits==True. LIVE GAP: gap_pace=pace/gap_multiplier(avg_grade,mid_km,post20) from course_segments + CURRENT gap_curve.json. IGNORE stored gap_pace_*. Segment means observed vs live GAP by city. GAP-adjusted split = DW(live_gap second)/DW(live_gap first). Even-effort recommended paces from live multipliers. Elev null cities listed honestly; never invent. No race_records writes.
implementation: Streaming row-group aggregates from features_v2.parquet (pace_* only); live gap_substrate.gap.load_curve/gap_multiplier × course_segments; stored gap_pace_* ignored; gc between groups; no race_records writes.
answer_prose: On 2,512,860 valid finishers with live GAP coverage ≈99.98% (27 cities with elev segments), mean observed positive split is 0.115, while GAP-adjusted positive split falls to 0.039 (Δ -0.076). Much of the late fade looks like grade cost — even-effort pacing should follow the GAP-warped profile, not flat splits. Melbourne elev remains null; curve v2_27cities as_of 2026-09-07T00:31:38Z.
methodology_prose: Even-effort GAP: observed segment pace ÷ gap_multiplier(avg_grade, mid_km, post20) from course_segments × gap_curve.json (v2_27cities, md5 5bc86aa1714d5c31689539b6ce6d7f09). Stored features_v2 gap_pace_* from the older 6-major curve are ignored. Positive split = second/first half pace − 1; GAP-adjusted split uses live GAP paces. Never invent elev; race_records untouched. Grade-only OLS vs Huber caveat is in pack tables.
